name: Hornero Text Tools
description: Utility Tools 2.0 text tools: bar quick transform and compact dashboard detail with Uppercase, Lowercase, Title Case and Reverse plus character, word and line counts. Pure QML.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Utility Tools 2.0 (plugins#30): bar quick action with popover, compact Utilities dashboard detail panel and a declaration-only launcher entrypoint (not loaded until shell#250) over one tested pure-JS logic block; typed settings default to 1.x behaviour; Spanish catalog.
Dashboard text tools: four transforms with live character, word and line counts.

defaultMode.description: Transform preselected in the dashboard and used by the quick action (Uppercase, the 1.x default).

showCounts.description: Show character, word and line counts in the dashboard (the 1.x behaviour).
